result.title: Execution Logs Sway VLM Judges of Robot Progress
result.summary: Vision-language models now grade robot videos, and text placed beside the frames can change their verdicts. On clips where the robot is losing progress, we add one log line saying the robot is making progress. Across Gemini, Qwen and GPT judges, this flips correct verdicts to progress 10 to 35 percentage points more often than a neutral line does. A one-line warning that the log may be wrong removes most of this effect. Selected fake "task complete" claims flip half of Qwen's correct verdicts, against a tenth for unrelated log lines. They have no detectable effect on Gemini.

AI.brief_summary: 论文考察 VLM 评判机器人视频进度时是否会被帧旁文本带偏：在机器人实际退步的片段中加入一行「正在取得进展」的执行日志，统计 Gemini、Qwen、GPT 三类评判者误判为进展的比例上升幅度，并测试一行「日志可能有误」的提醒与伪造「任务完成」声明的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是文本旁路压过视觉证据的定量失败分析，可供核查 VLM 判断是否真正依据视觉内容、以及证据筛选与文本先验的竞争关系；但它只涉及评判输出层面，与 latent 推理状态如何生成和使用尚无直接联系。
